metric_definitions.EVAL_NAMES: 5-row held-out Eschau validation (4 occupation crops + the Gerson Mosbacher row). Selection-touched: used for keep-best and experiment selection. NOT an untouched test.
metric_definitions.EVAL12: 12-item secondary validation set (selection-touched in earlier v2/v3 rounds).
metric_definitions.EVAL500_mm006: 500-row MM corpus hold-out. Date-flattered: overstates register-cell ability.
metric_definitions.EVAL_SEEDS_FIT: 12 trained seed cells re-scored. Fit-check only; proves learnability, NOT generalization.
metric_definitions.untouched_test: Reserved for a future verified labeling wave (incl. g01 twins row). Never trained on, never used for selection.

runs.verdict: mm006 improved sharply but target-domain (register cells) collapsed: underfit on Eschau cells (each of 170 cells seen ~once among 62,963 MM lines).
